app_info.subtitle: Work with Realinsight data
app_info.description: Find and analyze your Realinsight records, dashboards, reports, and configuration. View your connected customer and environment, switch connections, and create entities with initial fields or make supported updates after explicit approval.

test_cases.description: Find a named loan in the authenticated customer.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the loan named Riverfront Center and show me the matching Realinsight records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded matching entities in the signed-in customer's Realinsight data so the user can select or inspect the correct loan.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the latest servicing child record for known loans.
test_cases.user_prompt: For these loan records, show me the latest servicing record for each one.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns at most one latest matching child reference per supplied parent using the requested child date or order field.

test_cases.description: Read a selected cached portfolio analytic.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the selected portfolio analytic and summarize the current cached rows and columns.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded customer-scoped analytic result with column metadata and available cached rows for summarization.

test_cases.description: Create an approved LIST report after validation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using the report design we just validated, create the approved loan maturity LIST report in my agent folder.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the validated private report after explicit approval and summarizes its name, grain, saved configuration, and warnings.

test_cases.description: Apply an approved model form map update with conflict protection.
test_cases.user_prompt: Apply the approved map patch to this model form using the latest conflict token.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates only the approved model form metadata or map sections after authorization and conflict-token checks, then summarizes the changes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated email requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to the borrower asking for the missing documents.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it cannot send email or messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for public web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for today's commercial mortgage rates and breaking market news.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it only accesses authenticated Realinsight data and does not search the public web.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not perform unsupported identity administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reset another user's password and grant them administrator access.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because user credential and permission administration are outside its supported tools.
